transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a really long time now. It has been going on for about a year and ten months, and I just can't seem to lift my mood.
Have you had any periods of feeling completely back to your usual mood for more than two months during this time?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to my normal self at all. This depressed mood has been completely continuous and persistent for the entire year and ten months. I haven't had any breaks from it, not even for a few weeks.
